hero.heading: What to expect
hero.intro: Starting therapy takes three steps. You will know what each one involves before it begins.

items.title: Consultation
items.body: A short call with the clinician you chose. You share what brings you in; they explain how they work. If it is not the right fit, they will help you find someone who is.

items.title: Assessment
items.body: Your first full session. We review your history, what has helped and what has not, and agree on clear goals. You leave with a written plan.

items.title: The work
items.body: Regular sessions at a consistent time. Early on, weekly is best. We review progress together and adjust the plan as you change.

formats.heading: Same care, in the room or on screen.
formats.body: Meet in our [City] office, or by secure video from anywhere in [State]. You can switch between them.

image.alt: Laptop on a quiet desk in morning light

closingCta.heading: Begin with a consultation.
closingCta.body: Choose a clinician, then a time.

seo.title: What to Expect · Starting Therapy
seo.description: Starting therapy takes three steps: a free consultation, an assessment, then regular sessions in person or online.
